coordinate_convention: Position (100x,-100y,100z). Lights use reflected Blender local -Z forward/+Y up; PlayerStart uses reflected local +X forward/+Z up.
limitations: Source energy/color/type retained exactly in metadata. Unreal photometry and exposure differ; importer numeric conversions are only adjustable starting estimates.
Area disk/ellipse converted to rectangular light approximation; spot blend mapped approximately.
Blender world, fog/volume, camera, render-only moon/haze and compositing effects excluded.
Spawn clearance, player orientation, light mobility/performance/shadows and gameplay require Unreal testing.
